mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a single month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies report lower earnings.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a single month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth accelerates.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors gain confidence in the economy.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in a single month signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the broader economy benefits from increased construction activity.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increases by more than 5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a single month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth accelerates.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a strengthening economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 increases over two consecutive quarters.
